subject: mathematics
concept: Graphing quadratic functions and identifying key features (vertex, axis of symmetry, roots)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student plots a table of quadratic values on a physical grid to see the parabola shape emerge
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a quadratic equation to its correctly graphed parabola, vertex, and roots
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the vertex, axis of symmetry, and roots from a given quadratic function

misconception_flags: confuses the roots (x-intercepts) with the vertex coordinates

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
